# Before the session {background-color="#E3120B" style="color:#F7F4ED"}

::: {style="margin-top: 1.0em; color:#F7F4ED"}
### Who wrote the rules multinationals play by — and what happens when the writers' share shrinks?
:::

## What to do, and how long it takes

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Read Baldwin, *The Great Convergence* — Introduction, Parts I–II | 60–75 min |
| **2** | Collect the WDI extract from DataBank | 15 min |
| **3** | Shortlist three multinationals for your team | 15 min |
| **4** | Self-check | 15 min |

::: {.warn}
Teams form in the first ten minutes of the practice. No two teams the same firm — first come, first served.
:::

## 1 · Read Baldwin

**Baldwin (2016), *The Great Convergence*, Belknap / Harvard UP**

| | Annotate |
|---|---|
| **1** | The **three costs**: moving goods, ideas, people — which fell when |
| **2** | Why unbundling 1 → **divergence**, unbundling 2 → **convergence** |
| **3** | The **G7 share** figure: units, years, source |
| **4** | One claim a G7 multinational's strategy team would **contest** |

::: {.get}
**Target figure:** the G7 share of world GDP. Note whether it is current dollars, constant dollars or PPP.
:::

## 2 · Collect the WDI extract

::: {.step}
[DataBank → World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators)
:::

| Choose | |
|---|---|
| **Countries** | `CAN FRA DEU ITA JPN GBR USA` · `CHN KOR IND POL IDN THA` · World |
| **Series** | `NY.GDP.MKTP.CD` · `NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD` · `NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS` |
| **Time** | 1970 → latest |
| **Download** | Excel → `02-…/data/raw/` |

::: {.warn}
There is **no G7 aggregate** in WDI. You will build it.
:::

## 3 · Shortlist your firm

A good team firm:

- publishes **revenue by country or region**
- operates in **three or more** of: US, EU, China, Russia, the Gulf, India
- is exposed to sanctions, export controls, cyber or standards

::: {.muted}
Bring three names. Register the team's choice on ZoneCours before you leave class.
:::

## 4 · Self-check

1. What did **Bretton Woods** (1944) create? What did the **GATT** (1947) add?
2. What was unbundled in the **first** unbundling? In the **second**?
3. Market exchange rates or **PPP**: which gives the G7 a larger share, and why?
4. Rodrik's **trilemma**: name the three.

## Arrive with

::: {.check}
- Baldwin read, target figure understood
- WDI extract in `data/raw/`, logged
- Three candidate multinationals
- Self-check on paper
- Risk Brief today? `.twbx` on ZoneCours before class
:::
